title: AIEF Audit Findings Report
description: Machine-checkable OUTPUT CONTRACT for a `full audit check` / Rule 38 audit run (deliverable #45, V32.60). Adapted (reference-and-adapt, MIT) from cloudflare/security-audit-skill's report-schema.json. Every finding carries the four taxonomy axes — severity, confidence, dataFlowRole, preconditions — plus mandatory non-empty evidence. FLOOR-NOT-CEILING: this contract standardizes a finding's SHAPE so findings are comparable, sortable and machine-checkable; it NEVER caps what an audit may report. The paired validator is scripts/validate-findings.mjs (zero-dep, advisory, always exit 0).

schemaVersion.description: Contract version. Bump only on a breaking field change.

generator.description: What produced this report — a swarm label (e.g. 'full-audit-check-trigger.md swarm'), a tool name, or an agent id.

target.description: TARGET-NEUTRAL label for what was audited — a repo / app / surface name. NEVER a person; the report describes the code, not the author.

generated.description: ISO-8601 timestamp. Injected at file-write time only; omitted from the deterministic in-memory object so the object is byte-stable.

summary.description: Derived counts. May be regenerated from `findings` by the validator.

id.description: Stable identifier for the finding (dedupe key across re-runs).

severity.description: Impact rank — real-defect > drift > advisory > nit. Ties to audit.md §6 buckets: critical/high = the CRITICAL/HIGH blocking tiers, medium/low = advisory, info = nit.

confidence.description: Adversarial-disproof verdict. CONFIRMED = survived a fresh agent's attempt to falsify it (a precondition/code-path proving it real). PLAUSIBLE = could neither be confirmed nor disproven — downgraded, never dropped silently.

dataFlowRole.description: Where in the data flow the finding sits — an untrusted SOURCE, a dangerous SINK, a SANITIZER, a PASSTHROUGH link, or NONE (not a data-flow finding).

preconditions.description: The conditions that must hold for the finding to be real/exploitable (the adversarial-disproof output). An empty array means unconditional.

evidence.description: REQUIRED, non-empty. Each entry is a concrete anchor — a `file:line`, a grep-hit, or a command-output line. 'Every finding names its evidence.'

dimension.description: Optional — the audit dimension (e.g. 'D1-security') or coverage-ledger unit (surface × boundary × dimension) this finding belongs to.
